hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if (-not $f) { $f = $j.tool_response.filePath }; if ($f -match "(^|/)package\.json$|(^|/)tsconfig[^/]*\.json$|(^|/)turbo\.json$|(^|/)\.oxlintrc\.json$|(^|/)\.oxfmtrc\.json$|(^|/)\.claude/rules/.*\.md$|packages/db/.*schema") { $ctx = "Structural file changed ($f) - check whether docs/architecture/*.md (esp. architecture.md, tech-stack.md) or .claude/rules/tech-stack.md need updating before finishing this task. Use the docs-guardian subagent if so."; $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PostToolUse"; additionalContext = $ctx } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }

$j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if (-not $f) { $f = $j.tool_response.filePath }; if ($f -and ($f -match "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$") -and ($f -notmatch "\.(test|spec)\.[jt]sx?$") -and ($f -notmatch "[\\/](dist|node_modules|\.turbo|__tests__)[\\/]")) { $ctx = "Source file changed ($f) - run bunx fallow audit (changed-file gate) to check for dead code, unused exports, circular deps, and architecture-boundary violations before finishing this task."; $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PostToolUse"; additionalContext = $ctx } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }
